title: Bank statement body
description: What the Bank states a holder has and owes at a time (bank-insurer.md 3, register row DK19; spec-delta S280). Signed by the Bank. The log refuses a statement whose balance or owed amount differs from its own ledger, so a statement is recomputable from the log. Chain: none (prev is null).

locks.description: The credits the holder has locked as the backer of Bonds not yet settled, one entry for each contract (DK181; spec-delta S462). The log checks the list against its own record of the holder's locks, so a wrong or incomplete list is refused.
